name: Biophilia Organic Farm
tagline: Biophilia Organic Farm in Jamesport, New York
description: Biophilia Organic Farm is a CSA (community-supported agriculture) farm in 211 Manor Ln, NY. Members receive a season-long share of the farm's harvest, supporting local growing while getting fresh, seasonal produce. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
